body_lead: Odisha has approved technology projects worth about Rs 1.45 lakh crore, led by a proposed Rs 1.05 lakh crore integrated data centre. The projects were cleared at the 46th meeting of the High-Level Clearance Authority (HLCA), chaired by Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi. The authority approved 27 projects with a combined proposed investment of Rs 2,47,115.70 crore across 15 districts, with the projects having the potential to create 50,162 jobs, according to the state government. The IT, IT-enabled services and data-centre projects alone account for about Rs 1,42,941 crore.
